items.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022
items.q: I think — was that when George Garzone sat in?

ctx.x: Right. And I’m going to jump to this because I watched a couple of videos of you and I’ll get this together. When you were talking to Marian McPartland you were talking about different gigs and, “a little club where people aren’t really listening” you had addressed some question of hers. And then I watched this thing and you were playing “Body and Soul” in this club and it was so noisy.
I think — was that when George Garzone sat in?
That’s when George was there. And I thought it was so interesting because this is reality, ladies and gentlemen.
